summary: Iteration 21 - Suped DMARC Integration Testing Complete. All 21 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tested successfully: Client Subscriptions Tab with green/red service bars, toggle functionality, save to database, subscription status column in clients list, and Settings Page Suped API Key card.
critical_code_review_comments: All 6 Suped services properly displayed with clickable toggle bars
Active services show green bars with CheckCircle icon, inactive show red bars with XCircle icon
Suped Org ID input field in client subscriptions tab works correctly
Save button persists subscriptions to MongoDB client_subscriptions collection
Clients list view shows subscription status column with shield icon and active/total count (e.g., '3/6')
Settings Page has Suped DMARC Monitoring card with API key input and save functionality
API key is properly masked in GET response (only last 8 chars visible)
DMARC records proxy endpoint returns appropriate messages when API key or Org ID not configured
Previous features (Rentals, Vendors, Ticket Settings) regression tested - all working
seed_data_creation: Test subscriptions created for client-002 (TechStart Inc) with 3 active services
context_for_next_testing_agent: Suped DMARC integration fully implemented and tested. Suped settings stored in 'settings' collection with type='suped'. All data-testid attributes in place for testing.
